faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover Autobiography use?
faqLeft.a: The L460-generation Autobiography uses BMW-sourced V8s — specifically, the N63 for the standard V8 tier and the S68 for the performance/flagship tier. Both are 4.4-litre twin-turbo "hot-vee" designs. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Range Rover Autobiography engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500, for either BMW V8 code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Autobiography?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the BMW N63 or the BMW S68 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild BMW N63 Autobiography engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals, and coolant components as standard on every N63 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild BMW S68 Autobiography engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The S68 shares the hot-vee family pattern with the N63, and we service it to the same standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Autobiography engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Autobiography if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an Autobiography engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Autobiography owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
